title: Dashlet sprint pocket — quick experiment tally
content:
One-line purpose: tiny, daily tally for short runs (fast decisions). Use as my day-to-day scratchsheet for small perf/cost experiments.

HOW I USE THIS
- quick capture after a run (5–10 min)
- keep latest 8 runs on top, archive older weekly
- minimal fields, focus on p50/p95, cost, and obvious regressions

TABLE (top = newest)
run_id,date,model_variant,batch,quant,cache_prefetch,seq_len,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,success,notes
r-2026-02-18-01,2026-02-18,redwood-3b-fp16,8,fp16,kv-prefetch,512,42,86,0.42,yes,stable but p95 spiky on cold start
r-2026-02-17-03,2026-02-17,redwood-3b-q4_0,16,q4_0,none,256,38,120,0.28,partial,good latency, output slightly terse
r-2026-02-16-02,2026-02-16,redwood-7b-fp16,4,fp16,kv-cache-hit,1024,95,210,1.12,yes,cache helped but cost high; try batch 8
r-2026-02-15-01,2026-02-15,redwood-3b-fp16,8,fp16,kv-prefetch,256,36,78,0.36,yes,baseline for prompt-v2
r-2026-02-13-02,2026-02-13,redwood-3b-q4_1,8,q4_1,kv-prefetch,256,41,95,0.22,no,decode failure 1/50, investigate tokenization edge-case
r-2026-02-11-01,2026-02-11,redwood-3b-fp16,32,fp16,none,128,30,62,0.30,yes,very low latency but memory pressure seen
r-2026-02-10-01,2026-02-10,redwood-3b-fp16,8,fp16,kv-cache-hit,512,39,84,0.40,yes,consistent
r-2026-02-09-01,2026-02-09,redwood-3b-q4_0,8,q4_0,none,512,44,102,0.25,partial,output quality check fails on factual recall

QUICK ACTIONS (today):
- [ ] Re-run r-2026-02-13-02 with updated tokenizer patch (PR 812)
- [ ] Try batch=16 on 7b-fp16 to measure p95 delta (cost tradeoff)
- [x] Flagged RED-4121 about decode error (linked)

OBSERVATIONS / NOTES (scratch):
- q4_0 gives best cost but occasional quality dips; q4_1 slightly safer on recall
- kv-prefetch reduces p95 on longer seqs but increases tail on cold starts (warming strategy?)
- batch 32 -> lower p50 but can increase p95 for mixed seq_len workloads (queueing skew)

OPEN QUESTIONS:
- Is there a cheap warmup ping we can run per model to avoid cold-start spikes? (cost vs benefit)
- Should we add a tiny prefill cache layer for newly loaded sessions? (saves 0.1s p95 on 512 seq)

LINKED QUICK REFERENCES / COMMANDS:
- perf-run: /scripts/run_perf.sh --model redwood-3b-fp16 --batch 8 --seq 512
- graph: perf-dashboard?model=redwood-3b-fp16&range=7d
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infer-runtime/pull/812 (tokenizer fix)

ARCHIVE RULES (manual):
- Weekly snap to team drive if any run has "no" in success column or p95 > 200ms
- Otherwise keep last 8 runs here, move older to monthly archive

END
